# superset_database_tables (Data Source)

Lists the tables and views Superset sees in a schema of a database connection, for example to create a dataset for each of them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_database_tables" "public" {
  database_name = "Warehouse"
  schema        = "public"
}

# One dataset per table of the schema.
resource "superset_dataset" "public" {
  for_each = { for table in data.superset_database_tables.public.tables : table.name => table if table.type == "table" }

  table_name    = each.key
  database_name = "Warehouse"
  schema        = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection.
- `schema` (String) Name of the schema.

### Read-Only

- `database_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the connection.
- `tables` (Attributes List) Tables and views of the schema, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tables))

<a id="nestedatt--tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tables`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the table or view.
- `type` (String) `table` or `view`.
